d076023626083f93.description: Build the Future of Football in Jeddah What if your passion for football could become something you lead, grow, and make your own? Stranger Soccer is expanding into new cities around the world and is looking for a License Owner / Operator to bring the Stranger Soccer experience to Jeddah. This isn't a traditional management position. It's an opportunity to build, own, and grow a local football operation while becoming part of an established international brand. We're looking for entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about football and driven to create a meaningful impact in their local community. Imagine Being the Person Who... Brings football players together through a seamless mobile platform Builds a vibrant football community in Jeddah Creates memorable playing experiences week after week Leads a growing local operation backed by proven technology and global expertise What You'll Do As the License Owner / Operator, you'll oversee every aspect of Stranger Soccer, including: Growing the local player community Securing football venues and partnerships Recruiting and managing Official Hosts Leading marketing and community-building initiatives Delivering consistently outstanding game experiences You'll have the independence to grow your local operation while receiving ongoing support, technology, and operational guidance from our Singapore headquarters. Why Stranger Soccer? Stranger Soccer makes playing football as simple as booking a gym session. Through our mobile app, players can discover games, reserve a spot, and simply turn up to play. Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates in 10+ cities worldwide and has delivered more than 100,000 games. Our proven model is built for growth—and we're ready to bring it to Jeddah. Who We're Looking For A football enthusiast with strong local insight An entrepreneurial self-starter who enjoys taking ownership A leader who can build relationships and grow a local community Someone looking for more than a job—someone who wants to create lasting impact Ready to Take the Lead? Visit www.strangersoccer.com and explore "Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City" to learn more and express your interest. Help shape the future of football in Jeddah—and build something you'll be proud of.

d07acadf0473fd22.description: About the Role Fakeeh Care Group is seeking a Help Desk Coordinator to join their team in Al Diriyah Al Jadidah Dist, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on assisting internal staff with maintenance-related issues through effective process management, incident handling, and clear communication regarding faults and service requests. Role Overview The Help Desk Coordinator provides essential user support and customer service via telephone and company-supported applications. Key responsibilities include monitoring relevant software, diagnosing issues, and keeping requesters informed about resolution steps and timelines to manage expectations effectively. The role requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Respond to assistance requests or reports received via telephone, electronically, or verbally. Answer queries clearly and research questions to provide relevant information. Diagnose issues using appropriate questioning techniques to establish a resolution process. Quickly assess the scope and impact of incidents and escalate urgent situations as needed. Advise users on actions to be taken, adhering to standard operating procedures for help desk operations. Act as a liaison between requestors and the resolution unit, redirecting problems to the correct resource. Create Work Requests in Oracle based on the requestor's needs, understanding the importance and priority for escalation. Record all help desk interactions, administer help desk software, and track documentation of problem resolution. Update daily status and shift-handover reports, staying current with system information and changes. Follow access control and key management policies to maintain security for persons and property. Monitor fire alarm systems to ensure the safety and security of patients and caregivers. Manage the Building Management System in relation to received requests. Continuously supervise the Building Temperature Monitoring System. Follow up on incidents and record details of Emergency Codes. Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of the job. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Fakeeh Care Group.

d080d6d6546975af.description: About the Role NOMAC is seeking an Electrical Technician to join its team. This full-time position involves executing various maintenance activities on plant equipment under the direction of an Electrical Supervisor or Engineer. The role requires strict adherence to safety protocols and focuses on ensuring efficient and effective operations within the plant environment. Key Responsibilities Perform all preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance activities, including annual outage and overhauling work, in a safe and timely manner. Comply with NOMAC safety rules and regulations and applicable maintenance procedures and work instructions. Document maintenance concerns and history for assigned equipment. Report spare parts and consumables requirements to the Electrical Supervisor/Engineer and monitor spare parts availability. Ensure proper isolations are carried out before commencing maintenance activities, in coordination with the Electrical Supervisor and local operator. Troubleshoot, diagnose problems, and perform maintenance on electrical equipment within jurisdiction. Install, adjust, inspect, service, and repair static and rotating electrical equipment used in power and desalination plants. Prepare for all necessary electrical maintenance tasks for assigned equipment or areas. Maintain 5S housekeeping standards in the work area. Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 4-5 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance. A strong understanding of electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and protection drawings related to plant equipment is essential. The role requires working knowledge of equipment operation and associated operating systems. Work Environment This position requires readiness to work in a remote location. The Electrical Technician will operate within a plant environment, collaborating closely with supervisors and operators to ensure operational continuity and safety.

d0959c98ae659e9e.description: About MarkAble International MarkAble International is seeking a Sales Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, hybrid role that offers flexibility for partial work from home. The company focuses on delivering event management and marketing solutions to clients. Role Overview The Sales Specialist is responsible for identifying and engaging with prospective clients to present the company's event management and marketing solutions. This role is central to driving revenue growth through the implementation of effective sales strategies and maintaining strong client relationships. Key Responsibilities Conducting client meetings to understand needs and present solutions. Preparing detailed proposals tailored to client requirements. Negotiating contracts to secure new business. Maintaining strong relationships with both existing and potential customers. Collaborating with internal teams to align client requirements with MarkAble International’s services. Ensuring timely follow-up on all client interactions and proposals. Supporting the delivery of high-quality outcomes for clients. Tracking sales performance and contributing to sales forecasts. Participating in ongoing sales training and market research to stay informed of industry trends. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role offers a hybrid work model, allowing for partial work from home flexibility.

d0ac5e857c7bdc12.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Loyalty Product Operations Senior Specialist for an internship position in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This role involves leading the operational delivery, reliability, and continuous improvement of the Nuhdeek loyalty program across various channels including stores, app, web, and partner channels. The specialist will ensure effective execution of loyalty processes, accurate member and transaction records, reliable points and rewards fulfillment, and timely resolution of operational issues. Key Responsibilities Manage daily operational delivery of the Nuhdeek program across all channels, ensuring consistent application of policies and service standards. Verify transaction completion, balances, and reward fulfillment, coordinating corrections and reversals with proper records and approvals. Maintain operating procedures, service standards, FAQs, and operational guidance, applying approved rules consistently. Achieve agreed operational KPIs for Nuhdeek, addressing performance gaps through corrective actions. Configure approved points promotions, membership benefits, coupons, vouchers, and gift cards in collaboration with relevant teams. Validate eligibility, dates, calculations, limits, and refund behavior through user acceptance testing before activation. Own the loyalty issue queue from various channels, prioritizing resolution based on severity and guest impact within agreed SLAs. Escalate critical outages and widespread balance errors, coordinating service updates and guest remediation. Own the operational improvement backlog, translating product priorities into process enhancements and system requirements. Lead business user acceptance testing (UAT) and operational readiness, maintaining test evidence and verifying benefits post-release. Monitor loyalty engine, portal, POS, app, web, and CRM interfaces, tracking transaction performance against SLAs. Reconcile points issued, redeemed, reversed, expired, and outstanding against source transactions with Finance and IT. Lead member data quality checks, duplicate resolution, and access reviews with IT and Analytics. Train pharmacists, Guest Care Center (GCC), and Operations Excellence teams, maintaining playbooks and coordinating loyalty materials. Monitor and report operational performance, identifying recurring issues and improvement opportunities. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Ability to translate approved business priorities and operational requirements into effective processes and system enhancements. Experience working closely with IT, Omni-Channel, Finance, Guest Care, and technology partners. Demonstrated ability to manage day-to-day operational delivery and ensure consistent application of policies. Proficiency in configuring promotions, benefits, coupons, and gift cards. Experience in incident resolution and guest support, including tracking root causes and implementing corrective actions. Familiarity with system reliability monitoring and integration support. Knowledge of financial reconciliation processes for loyalty programs. Experience in data quality management and operational controls. Work Environment This role is primarily based indoors (100%). The work schedule is 5 working days per week with 2 days off. Working hours are from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one-hour break.

d009f032f2ba24b6.description: About the Role Elaf Group is seeking a Digital Marketing and Design Specialist to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves planning and producing creative and digital content for Elaf Group, Elaf Hotels, and Joudyan Hotels, ensuring high-quality design, technical execution, and consistent brand presentation across all digital channels. The specialist will also support customer relationship management (CRM) activities. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage the quarterly content calendar, producing and coordinating creative content. Coordinate hotel offers and promotional campaigns with the Director. Support CRM activities through customer segmentation, marketing automation planning, email campaign execution, and performance monitoring. Monitor and report on bookings and revenue attributable to email and CRM campaigns. Coordinate the use of freelance design and copywriting resources within the approved budget. Develop and coordinate social media and email content aligned with marketing objectives and brand positioning. Plan and execute customer-focused email campaigns, including audience segmentation and customer reactivation. Produce digital and visual content for guest-facing communication channels and tools, such as websites, booking engines, and in-room television content. Ensure email campaigns comply with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) regarding recorded consent. Coordinate with digital agencies on creative requirements, campaign assets, media plan activation, and social media moderation. Brief and coordinate assigned freelance designers and a bilingual Arabic-English copywriter. Review and validate external deliverables against approved briefs, brand standards, and quality requirements. Design and produce social media content, campaign creatives, presentations, and other digital marketing materials. Produce and edit video content, proposing creative concepts for review and approval. Schedule and publish approved digital content according to the agreed plan. Ensure all creative materials comply with approved brand guidelines, maintaining brand differentiation. Maintain and organize brand guideline files and archive approved designs, videos, and email campaigns. Write, design, build, test, and execute email campaigns, ensuring accuracy and alignment with objectives. Monitor the quality, completeness, and consent status of the customer database. Prepare CRM performance reports covering attributable bookings, revenue, database growth, and customer engagement. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing and design. Demonstrated ability to plan and produce creative and digital content. Experience with CRM activities, including customer segmentation and marketing automation. Proficiency in design software and video editing tools. Understanding of brand guidelines and consistent brand presentation. Knowledge of data protection laws (*, PDPL) related to email campaigns. Collaboration and Coordination The role requires close coordination with the Director of Marketing & Communications, the Marketing and Branding Specialist, the Events and Communications Manager, and designated hotel marketing contacts. Collaboration extends to various Group departments, including Reservations, Front Office, Revenue, and IT, to facilitate content collection and campaign execution. The specialist will also work with external digital agencies and freelance resources. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah. The role involves working within a dynamic marketing and communications team, supporting multiple hotel brands under the Elaf Group. The specialist will manage various digital channels and ensure compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Application Process Interested candidates with the required experience are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

d0ac2ba124de18c9.description: Director CX & Satisfaction Lead the City Operations CX and Satisfaction function, translating Qiddiya-wide CX strategies, customer journeys, standards, and service principles into coordinated operational delivery across city services, assets, events, frontline operations, and customer touchpoints. The role oversees CX planning and execution, customer intelligence, satisfaction measurement, feedback management, service quality assurance, and improvement initiatives, ensuring customer insights are converted into clear operational priorities and actions As the principal City Operations CX point of contact, the Director aligns stakeholders across QIC and City Operations to embed consistent customer experiences and continuously improve the end-to-end resident and visitor journey. · Establish and lead the City Operations CX and Satisfaction function, integrating CX Improvement, Customer Intelligence, and CX Planning and Execution within a unified operating framework with clear priorities, delivery mechanisms, interfaces, and accountabilities. · Lead, develop, and manage the CX and Satisfaction team, setting clear objectives and accountabilities, building team capabilities, managing performance, and ensuring coordinated delivery across the function in line with the growth, evolving operational requirements, and maturity of City Operations. · Translate Qiddiya-wide CX objectives, strategies, customer journeys, principles, and standards into operational requirements, initiatives, guidelines, surveys, and coordinated delivery plans for City Operations. · Lead the implementation of CX programmes, projects, standards, and service principles across relevant City Operations functions, frontline operations, and customer touchpoints. · Oversee CX training needs and periodic training programmes for frontline operators to support the consistent application of CX guidelines, procedures, and service principles. · Lead the rollout of customer surveys and data-collection tools, and oversee the capture, consolidation, and analysis of feedback from digital channels, frontline touchpoints, complaints, and other sources, in alignment with DMMO, Strategy, and other relevant CX functions. · Oversee the development and monitoring of CX performance indicators, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms, translating customer insights, satisfaction results, service quality findings, and recurring trends into prioritised improvement initiatives and executive-level recommendations. · Lead operational CX improvement and service quality assurance across City Operations, including site visits, quality reviews, and cross-functional action plans, escalating material gaps and improvement opportunities where required. · Coordinate the cross-functional resolution of City Operations-related customer issues, ensuring timely follow-up, clear accountability, root-cause analysis, and escalation of recurring or systemic themes to the appropriate QIC stakeholders. · Ensure CX requirements are embedded in readiness assessments and operational plans for new city assets, districts, and major events, in coordination with relevant development, asset management, event, and operational stakeholders. Generic Responsibilities · Act as the principal City Operations point of contact for CX, leading stakeholder engagement across QIC and City Operations to align priorities, coordinate interfaces, and drive the consistent implementation of CX standards, initiatives, and improvement actions. · Coordinate with DMMO on event experience requirements, asset-launch customer journeys, service priorities, satisfaction insights, recurring customer issues, and improvement plans, translating agreed requirements into City Operations readiness and delivery actions. · Coordinate with Strategy to implement CX strategies and plans across City Operations touchpoints, embed policies and guidelines into frontline practices, and share live-operations feedback and customer insights to refine CX strategies and solutions. · Provide relevant QIC teams and City Operations functions with operational requirements, dependencies, feasibility input, service gaps, customer pain points, and frontline delivery challenges to support coordinated planning and decision-making. · Provide CX-related operational requirements, readiness input, frontline coordination, and post-implementation performance feedback for asset launches and major events. · Establish a coordinated operational view of CX data and day-to-day performance, supporting a consistent source of information for decision-making, governance, and continuous improvement. KEY INTERACTIONS: Key External Interactions · Destination Management and Marketing Office (DMMO) · QIC Strategy · Q-Tech - Guest Center · Transport CX and other QIC CX functions · External operators, service providers, survey partners, and CX technology vendors relevant to the approved delivery model. Key Internal Interactions · Chief of City Operations and City Operations leadership · City Operations verticals and functions, including City Command Unit, Operational Planning and Performance, City Assets O&M, Security Operations, FLS Operations, Medical Operations, Events Planning and Management, and City ICT Operations · City Operations frontline/on-ground operating teams. Minimum Qualifications · Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management, Tourism, Operations Management, Service Design, Social Sciences or a related discipline. Professional Certifications · Relevant certification in customer experience, service design, or programme management is advantageous. Skills · Strong knowledge of customer experience operations, service quality assurance, customer feedback systems, satisfaction measurement, customer journeys, and frontline service delivery. · Demonstrated ability to establish and lead new functions, develop operating models and governance frameworks, and drive cross-functional accountability in complex environments, including through influence where direct reporting authority is limited. · Ability to translate enterprise CX direction, standards, and customer journeys into practical operational requirements, training, controls, and improvement initiatives. · Strong capability in customer intelligence, survey design, insight generation, trend analysis, performance reporting, and evidence-based prioritisation. · Strong cross-functional leadership, stakeholder alignment, issue resolution, escalation, and executive communication skills. · Ability to lead the implementation of CX improvements across complex city services, asset launches, major events, and high-volume customer environments. · Strategic leadership, decision-making, team development, delivery orientation, collaboration, and customer centricity. Experience · 10+ years of relevant experience in customer experience, guest experience, service quality, customer intelligence, or a related field, including demonstrated experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams. Nature of Experience · Demonstrated experience leading, developing, and managing multidisciplinary CX and satisfaction teams, including setting priorities, building team capabilities, managing performance, and ensuring coordinated delivery. · Senior-level experience in customer experience, guest experience, service quality, customer intelligence, or a comparable operational leadership field. · Experience leading customer-facing operational improvement and cross-functional CX implementation in a destination, hospitality, large-scale entertainment, tourism, mixed-use city, or similarly complex operating environment. · Experience using customer feedback, satisfaction measures, operational performance data, and frontline insights to define, prioritise, and deliver service improvement initiatives. · Experience engaging senior stakeholders and coordinating delivery across strategy, destination management, technology, asset, event, and operational functions.

d0d6939ef2aeed5c.description: نبحث عن مساعد شيف بيكري متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في إعداد وتقديم مجموعة متنوعة من المخبوزات عالية الجودة. ستكون مسؤولاً عن دعم الشيف الرئيسي في جميع جوانب الإنتاج، بما في ذلك تحضير المكونات، والخبز، والتزيين، والحفاظ على معايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. إذا كنت تمتلك شغفاً بالخبز، وقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق، وتلتزم بالدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل، فإننا ندعوك للتقديم. مهام ومسؤوليات مساعد شيف بيكري: * المساعدة في تحضير وعجن وخبز العجائن والمعجنات المختلفة. * تزيين الكيك والحلويات وتطبيق اللمسات النهائية حسب المواصفات. * ضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل والمعدات المستخدمة. * اتباع الوصفات والتعليمات بدقة لضمان جودة المنتج واتساق الطعم. * المساعدة في إدارة المخزون والتأكد من توفر المواد الخام اللازمة.

d0cd77cf86a4c607.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business comprising independent entities with operations in 30 countries. Established in 1945, the group employs approximately 11,000 people from over 40 nationalities. Its activities span automotive distribution, auto parts manufacturing, financial services, renewable energy, environmental services, health, land and real estate development, logistics, electronics retailing, and media services. The term Abdul Latif Jameel refers to a group of distinct and wholly separate legal entities, not a single corporate entity or conglomerate. The Role of Plant Manager Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Plant Manager to oversee operations in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and is crucial for managing the effective installation of vehicle accessories and developing the plant team. Key Responsibilities Manage, monitor, and develop associates by organizing necessary training in accessories installation and other skills. Maintain strong team member relations and ensure fair work rules are implemented. Monitor staff attendance and enforce company procedures related to absences, tardiness, and performance. Implement the annual training plan for all associates, conduct monthly KPI evaluations, and schedule vacations. Maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) in adherence to ISO 9001:2015 regulations. Review and confirm monthly incentives for all plant staff. Coordinate with Quality Control (QC) to address repetitive parts failures or defects and initiate necessary actions. Communicate with the manpower controller regarding associate requirements, including Associate Care and Finance issues. Collaborate with relevant groups (PIO Planning, Main/sub warehouse, and VLD) to resolve delays in accessory delivery and vehicle availability to maintain production. Implement the Toyota Production System (TPS) by improving production methods, safety, and equipment performance to enhance installation quality. Ensure overall plant compliance with standardized procedures, requirements, and applicable environmental regulations. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience in managing the effective installation of vehicle accessories. Proven ability to develop and monitor teams, including the creation of succession plans within a department. 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, serving operations in Jeddah and Makkah.

d096a14dbf458dcc.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare is seeking a Consultant Orthodontist (Locum) to join its Dental Service. This full-time role involves preventing, diagnosing, and correcting deviations in dental and dentofacial growth, development, and position. The Consultant Orthodontist will provide Myofacial therapy and advise on serial extraction in preventive orthodontics, serving as a liaison and consultant within the Dental Division. Scope of Practice The Orthodontist will address the orthodontic needs of Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare and Aramco employees, dependents, and other eligible patients in accordance with Saudi Aramco guidelines. Services are delivered across seven dental clinics and one inpatient hospital, primarily in the Al-Ahsa and Al Qatif areas. Administrative and functional supervision for forecasting and service requirements is provided by the Chief of Specialty Dental Services. Key Responsibilities Work as part of the Orthognathic surgical team for the correction of facial deformities. Advise on dental occlusion during facial fracture treatment and recommend changes for patients undergoing periodontal treatment. Consult with Dentists on occlusion problems in prosthetic appliance construction and actively participate in these cases. Serve as an advisor to the Pediatric service on growth patterns and syndromes in newborns and young children. Act as a consultant to the surgical service for cleft palate and lip rehabilitation, actively participating in treatment. Record all pertinent data accurately and promptly in medical and dental records, including chief complaint, diagnosis, treatment, and recommendations. Make recommendations for orthodontic fee schedule revisions and maintain statistical analysis of workloads. Stay current with new orthodontic techniques and procedures, recommending and implementing approved advancements. Design, fabricate, or direct the fabrication of intra and extra oral orthodontic appliances, including advanced interceptive and functional appliances. Maintain current knowledge and sustained qualification in all cardio-pulmonary resuscitation programs and emergency techniques. Offer periodic lecture material on orthodontic matters as part of the in-house educational program. Ensure quality assurance within the Orthodontic unit through written reports, continuing education, and unit meetings. Provide consultative opinions and directions to other Dentists and Physicians on orthodontic matters. Monitor future needs for manpower and equipment within the unit. Ensure proper practice of infection control guidelines in all clinical areas. Qualifications and Requirements Licensed to practice orthodontics in the country/state of origin. Eligible to qualify for and maintain a Saudi Ministry of Health License. Meets Saudi Ministry of Health requirements for professional licensure and classification by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS). Must be classified as "Consultant" by the SCFHS. Thorough knowledge of medical ethics. A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in orthodontics is required for this role. Professional Contacts The role involves daily contact with employees, dependents, and approved general public patients. Frequent contact will be maintained with the Chief of Dental Services, Unit Head of Specialty Dental Services, dental staff, and technical personnel for coordination and consultation. Regular interaction with Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeons is required for Orthognathic surgical cases. Occasional contact with international orthodontists, local dentists for referrals, and manufacturer/vendor representatives for equipment and supplies will also occur.

d013b65465e9877b.description: About the Role ACE Gallagher is seeking a Bid Specialist to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for managing the entire bid process, ensuring that all proposals are compelling, compliant, and delivered on schedule. The position requires a strategic thinker with strong project management skills and a solid understanding of the insurance industry. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the bid process from initial opportunity identification through to contract award. Coordinate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business development, technical, legal/compliance, finance, and operations, to gather necessary information and inputs for bid submissions. Write, edit, and review bid content to ensure clarity, accuracy, and compliance with client requirements. Manage the production and delivery of high-quality bid documents, presentations, and proposals. Conduct thorough analysis of bid requirements, evaluation criteria, and the competitive landscape. Ensure all bids comply with internal governance processes and external regulations. Maintain a bid library and repository of standard content, templates, and best practices. Track and report on bid progress, success rates, and key performance indicators. Continuously improve bid processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Work closely with department heads (GI and EB) across multiple territories and maintain bid strategies that align with the company’s prospect and target lists. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. A deep understanding of the insurance industry is essential for success in this position. Behavioral Skills Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple bids simultaneously. Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines. High attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, within the Eastern region. The role involves working collaboratively with various internal teams and department heads across different territories.

d01b6953706697cb.description: About the Role Alfalak Electronic Equipment & Supplies Co. is seeking a Specialist ECA Funding to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time position is within a leading energy company's Funding Division, part of the Corporate Finance Department. The role focuses on originating, structuring, and executing Export Credit Agency (ECA)-supported and balance-sheet financing to ensure timely and cost-efficient corporate funding. Role Context and Environment The Specialist ECA Funding reports directly to the Divisional Manager, Funding. This is a high-volume, deadline-driven environment that is closely tied to the company’s capital expenditure and funding plan. The role requires an experienced finance professional capable of managing complex financial transactions. Key Responsibilities Structure and execute ECA-covered facilities, including direct lending and ECA-guaranteed tranches, in coordination with relevant ECAs. Support the origination and execution of corporate and balance-sheet syndicated facilities across local, regional, and international lender groups. Manage transactions end-to-end, encompassing term sheet negotiation, credit approval support, documentation, conditions precedent (CP) tracking, and drawdown. Lead bank liaison and relationship management with ECAs, MLAs, arrangers, and commercial lenders. Coordinate with legal counsel, advisors, and internal stakeholders on financing documentation and negotiations. Stay current on loan markets, pricing benchmarks, ECA programs, and product structures. Mentor and develop junior analysts within the team. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience as an Export Credit Agency (ECA) finance professional. Demonstrated experience in originating, structuring, and executing ECA-supported and balance-sheet financing. Proven ability to manage complex financial transactions from negotiation through to drawdown. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

d04ad698c6b77504.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking a Senior Engineer, Infrastructure & Utilities to join the team in Al Khafji, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of critical infrastructure and utilities systems that support operations. The Senior Engineer will oversee complex projects, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive operational efficiency across all infrastructure components. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and oversee infrastructure and utilities systems, including solutions for water, power, HVAC, and waste management. Manage infrastructure projects from conception through completion, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Conduct technical analysis and feasibility studies for new infrastructure initiatives and system upgrades. Prepare comprehensive technical documentation, specifications, and engineering drawings using CAD and BIM software. Ensure all infrastructure systems comply with Saudi Arabian regulations, international standards, and company policies. Lead and mentor junior engineers and technical staff, fostering continuous improvement and professional development. Identify operational inefficiencies and implement solutions to optimize system performance and reduce costs. Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders for material and service procurement. Conduct regular inspections and maintenance audits to ensure system reliability and safety. Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs and emergency response protocols. Analyze system performance data and prepare reports for management review and decision-making. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a detail-oriented and analytical professional with a strong background in infrastructure and utilities. This role requires an experienced engineer capable of making a significant impact on infrastructure capabilities in the region. Required Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in infrastructure and utilities engineering. Recruitment Process AECOM is committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process. All newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

d04ada7feb9737a3.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a PMO Governance and Reporting Specialist to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for supporting the effective operation of the Project Management Office (PMO) by maintaining governance standards, coordinating project reporting, monitoring portfolio performance, and ensuring compliance with established processes. The specialist will provide accurate, timely, and insightful information to support leadership decision-making and successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Maintain and continuously improve PMO governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures. Ensure projects adhere to approved delivery methodologies, controls, stage gates, and documentation requirements. Coordinate governance forums, including project review meetings, steering committees, and portfolio reviews. Prepare agendas, briefing materials, status packs, action logs, and meeting minutes. Track governance decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and actions through to resolution. Support project assurance reviews, health checks, audits, and compliance assessments. Maintain project and portfolio documentation, templates, standards, and process guidance. Promote consistent project management practices across business units and delivery teams. Reporting and Analysis Produce regular PMO reports, dashboards, scorecards, and executive summaries. Report on project status, milestones, schedule, budget, benefits, risks, issues, resources, and dependencies. Identify trends, exceptions, delivery risks, and areas requiring management attention. Develop insights and recommendations to improve project performance and decision-making. Ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, timely, and aligned with stakeholder requirements. Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc portfolio reports. Maintain reporting calendars and monitor submission deadlines. Stakeholder and Portfolio Support Collaborate with project managers, program managers, finance teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. Provide guidance to project teams on reporting requirements, governance expectations, and PMO processes. Support portfolio planning, prioritization, resource tracking, and capacity reporting. Assist with project onboarding, closure, lessons learned, and benefits tracking. Contribute to PMO continuous improvement and process automation initiatives. Support the implementation and administration of project management tools and reporting systems. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in PMO governance, reporting, and project support roles. Application Process Parsons is committed to diversity and equal employment opportunity. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

d04e1a78a3eac3eb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة لين للاستشارات المالية و للاستشارات المهنية عن أخصائي تحليل مالي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتحليل المواقف المالية وتحديد أولويات الإنفاق، بالإضافة إلى تحليل حركة تداول الأوراق المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الموقف المالي للجهات المعنية، بما في ذلك مصادر التمويل المتاحة وحجم الإنفاق المتوقع، وتحديد الأهمية والأولوية بالتنسيق مع تلك الجهات. تحليل سبل وأساليب ضغط النفقات في حالات العجز المالي، ودراسة فرص الاستثمار في حالات الوفر المالي، مع ترتيب أولويات الإنفاق والاستثمار بناءً على الموقف المالي. مراقبة وتحليل حركة تداول الأوراق المالية، ودراسة العوامل المؤثرة على تغير أسعارها، وتقدير القيم الحقيقية للأسهم، والتنبؤ بالتغيرات المستقبلية في الأسعار. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التحليل المالي ومواكبة أحدث التطورات والممارسات الدولية في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتحليل المالي، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التحليل المالي أو ما يعادله. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقف المالية وتحديد أولويات الإنفاق. مهارات تحليلية قوية في تداول الأوراق المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة لين للاستشارات المالية و للاستشارات المهنية، مما يوفر بيئة داعمة للنمو المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

d06d77873d3f4552.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسارات الصاعدة للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، مثل وحدات التدفئة ومضخاتها ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية. المهارات المطلوبة فهم جيد لمبادئ تصميم نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وتفسيرها. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان كفاءة وسلامة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في مختلف المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

d09d2836f437ad3b.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث المركز العربي للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على أعمال التشطيبات الداخلية للمباني، لضمان توافقها مع المواصفات والمعايير المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على جميع أعمال التشطيبات الداخلية للمباني. التأكد من مطابقة التشطيبات للمواصفات الفنية والمواد المعتمدة في التصميم. مراجعة وتحديد أماكن وضع قطع الأثاث داخل المساحات الداخلية لضمان الانسجام الوظيفي والجمالي. التنسيق مع فرق العمل المختلفة لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي أو الإشراف على التشطيبات. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية والتصاميم الداخلية. معرفة جيدة بالمواد المستخدمة في التشطيبات الداخلية وجودتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. دقة الملاحظة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التصميم الداخلي بدوام كامل في مقر المركز العربي للاستشارات الهندسية بالمدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع المشاريع للإشراف المباشر على أعمال التشطيبات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

d0add0536c4f0259.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Project Controls Engineer to support major refinery and petrochemical projects for a leading petrochemical client in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring effective project controls systems, accurate forecasting, and critical-path management for large-scale projects. Role Context and Objectives The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, monitoring, analyzing, and reporting project performance across various parameters including scope, cost, schedule, risk, quality, and safety. The role requires a strong background in project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, and performance reporting within EPCM and construction environments, ensuring alignment with approved project baselines. Key Responsibilities Provide guidance and specialized support for resolving complex project control issues. Calculate, analyze, report, and recommend actions based on project data, including schedule, cost, budget, risk, quality, and safety. Develop project cash-flow forecasts. Integrate scope, cost, and schedule within the Work Breakdown Structure and maintain accurate mapping. Analyze, evaluate, and forecast current project status against the approved baseline schedule. Assess the effects of design or construction changes and schedule slippages. Report schedule status to project management, Sadara management, and clients as applicable. Apply engineering, procurement, and construction terminology, concepts, and relationships. Develop and maintain critical-path logic networks and bar charts. Customize project control systems to meet specific project requirements. Accumulate and maintain historical performance data to support realistic future planning and forecasting. Guide and oversee EPCM & Construction contractors in setting up their project controls and reporting structure. Proactively verify and ensure accurate reporting from other project contractors. Supervise and support lower-level project controls engineers or support personnel when assigned. Perform other responsibilities associated with the position as required. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in project controls, specifically within major refinery and petrochemical projects. Demonstrated background in project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, and performance reporting. Experience working within EPCM and construction environments. Reporting and Coordination This role involves coordinating and overseeing contractors' project controls activities, providing guidance to project teams, and delivering reliable performance reports to project management and clients.

d0c1557cbcc4c418.description: About the Role Rgheeb is seeking an experienced Purchasing & Logistics Manager to oversee all procurement activities, manage supplier relationships, and optimize logistics operations. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring the timely procurement of materials and services at competitive prices while upholding quality standards and achieving cost savings. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement purchasing plans in coordination with warehouse, factory, and operations departments. Identify, evaluate, and manage suppliers, maintaining an approved supplier list. Negotiate supplier pricing, contracts, and purchasing terms. Issue purchase orders in accordance with the company's authority matrix. Monitor supplied material quality, manage returns, and resolve supplier-related issues. Establish alternative suppliers for critical materials to minimize supply chain disruptions. Coordinate with the marketing department for sample approvals and to ensure materials meet specifications. Plan and coordinate material transportation between suppliers, warehouses, factories, and branches. Ensure timely deliveries through effective coordination with warehouse and operations management. Analyze purchasing costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction. Monitor procurement savings against established reference prices. Identify opportunities to resell surplus materials and coordinate with the Finance Manager for pricing and invoicing approvals. Team Leadership and Reporting Supervise the purchasing and logistics team, delegate responsibilities, and monitor performance. Provide guidance, conduct performance evaluations, and identify development opportunities for team members. Monitor team attendance, punctuality, and compliance with company policies in coordination with Human Resources. Prepare detailed financial reports outlining procurement savings and calculation methodologies. Submit monthly executive reports to the General Manager covering procurement performance, cost savings, supplier performance, branch deliveries, operational challenges, and resale revenue. Perform additional departmental responsibilities as directed by the General Manager. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in purchasing and logistics management. Proven ability to manage procurement activities, supplier relationships, and logistics operations. Demonstrated experience in cost analysis and identifying cost reduction opportunities. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to lead and develop a team. Work Type This is a full-time position.

d0c459db3238a52d.description: About the Role Envisions Employment Solutions is seeking an Oracle AI Agent Studio Engineer for a full-time position with one of our partners, an IT Services and IT Consulting company. This role involves designing, building, and deploying AI agents on Oracle AI Agent Studio for a large industrial enterprise. Role Context The Oracle AI Agent Studio Engineer will collaborate with Oracle Fusion functional teams, who provide business and module context. The engineer will be responsible for applying agentic AI engineering principles to develop working agents connected to enterprise systems, leveraging their expertise in AI agent development within the Oracle ecosystem. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and deploy AI agents using Oracle AI Agent Studio. Translate business and module context from Oracle Fusion functional teams into agent designs and workflows. Develop agents utilizing LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, tool and function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. Integrate agents with enterprise systems through REST APIs and JSON. Operate within Oracle Fusion’s data model, security and roles, and extensibility framework. Utilize OCI Generative AI services to support agent capabilities. Apply AI governance, evaluation, and responsible AI practices throughout the development lifecycle. Required Qualifications and Experience 5+ years of experience in AI/ML or data science, including at least 2 years in Generative AI and agentic AI solutions. Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, tool/function calling, and multi-agent orchestration. Direct experience with Oracle AI Agent Studio. Experience integrating agents with enterprise systems via REST APIs and JSON. Familiarity with OCI Generative AI services. Understanding of AI governance, evaluation, and responsible AI practices. Preferred Skills and Experience Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications (data model, security and roles, API and extensibility basics) is preferred; full implementation experience is not required. Exposure to Fusion modules (HCM, ERP, or SCM). Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud. Proficiency in Python. Oracle certifications (OCI Generative AI Professional, OCI AI Foundations). Experience in mining, manufacturing, or industrial sectors. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d0e10c5478116d22.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Strategy Analyst to join their team in the Eastern region, covering Dhahran and Al Jubail. This full-time role supports the company's long-term growth by conducting detailed feasibility studies and contributing to strategic assessments. The Analyst provides structured, data-driven inputs for management decision-making and contributes directly to the annual strategic and budgeting cycle. Role Context and Purpose The Strategy Analyst supports the development of strategic projects by focusing on market opportunities, financial implications, and organizational readiness. This position is integral to informing the company's strategic direction and ensuring alignment with internal capabilities and external market dynamics. Key Responsibilities Conduct detailed feasibility studies under the direction of the Senior Analyst and Manager, covering market, financial, industrial, and competitive dimensions. Build and maintain analytical models, market sizing, and data sets that support strategic assessments, ensuring documentation of assumptions and sources for auditable findings. Support strategic assessments related to both organic growth (internal initiatives) and inorganic growth (*, M&A, partnerships, diversification). Gather and consolidate input from internal stakeholders to enhance analysis robustness and ensure alignment with functional realities. Prepare structured reports, deliverables, and presentation materials to support the strategic initiative review and approval process. Contribute insights and data to the 10-year planning and annual budgeting cycles by assisting in the development of long-term strategic scenarios. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, with operations in Dhahran and Al Jubail. The role involves working within a team dedicated to strategic planning and project development. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d08512c3db629539.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أوف برايس عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات شاملة ودقيقة للعملاء تتعلق بالمنتجات، استخداماتها، وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة بكفاءة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وفي بيئة مبيعات ديناميكية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة أوف برايس. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل منظمة وداعمة لجميع موظفيها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

d02da26aaaf23e32.description: Overview of the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Contracts & Claims Expert with a background in Railway (Rails) infrastructure projects and exposure to Operations & Maintenance (O&M). This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing contractual matters, claims, disputes, and ensuring compliance across railway O&M operations. Key Responsibilities The Contracts & Claims Expert will be responsible for contract management, claims, and dispute resolution within railway projects. This includes: Reviewing, drafting, and administering contracts related to railway O&M, track works, signaling, electrification, and rolling stock maintenance. Ensuring contractual compliance with FIDIC or equivalent railway contracts. Interpreting contract clauses and providing guidance to project teams on rights and obligations. Managing subcontractor agreements and ensuring alignment with main contract requirements. Identifying, evaluating, and preparing contractual claims, including Extension of Time (EOT), variations & orders, cost escalation claims, and disruption and delay claims. Preparing claim submissions, including documentation, narratives, and supporting evidence. Handling claim negotiations with clients, consultants, and subcontractors. Supporting dispute resolution processes, including mediation, arbitration, and adjudication. Required Qualifications Candidates should possess the following qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Railway Engineering, or Law. A postgraduate qualification in Construction Law or Contract Management is preferred. Experience and Skills The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience, demonstrating proficiency in: Railway infrastructure projects. Operations & Maintenance (O&M) contracts. Claims and dispute management. Hands-on experience with FIDIC or railway standard contracts. Prior experience in Metro Rail, High-speed rail, or Freight rail O&M projects is highly desirable. Work Environment This role is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, focusing on railway projects within the region.

d0398ac3a5c2c964.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إيشن موتورز عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على وضع سياسات البيع، متابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تطبيقها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المحتملة. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الفرص البيعية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وبناء العلاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب العمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يركز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتطوير استراتيجيات فعالة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم.

d068c7012a0125ba.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Testing and Commissioning Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and executing testing and commissioning activities for electrical substation protection and control systems, ensuring alignment with project targets for safety, quality, cost, and delivery, as well as contractual technical specifications. The position requires 7-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Organize and manage all substation tests, including preparing test plans and associated procedures. Execute all types of site tests for protection and control systems. Establish and update testing schedules in accordance with the overall project schedule. Manage site test equipment, such as digital multi-meters, injection sets, and watt-meters, ensuring valid calibration certificates. Verify that all site tests comply with contract requirements regarding quality and type. Issue and manage non-conformance reports as needed. Ensure all drawings are marked up for the preparation of as-built documentation. Centralize and file test reports, ensuring they are duly approved and signed by the Consultant or Client. Organize and manage backups of all equipment computer files, including protection relay settings and equipment configurations, for delivery with marked-up drawings. Ensure compliance with PMH, GRID Quality & EHS Policies, and IMS procedures. Record and report Quality Objectives & KPI data. Coordinate daily activities with the Client. Recommend field changes beneficial to plant operations or necessary for efficient commissioning. Prepare final Commissioning reports highlighting problem areas, recommended engineering changes, improvements in organizational efficiency, and personnel performance evaluations. Prepare monthly progress reports on Commissioning group activities, noting any negative events such as delays, design/erection errors, or missing spares. Verify adherence to safety procedures, including Permits, Method Statements, Risk Assessments, and LOTO, for all high-risk activities during operation sequences and equipment use. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or a relevant field. Minimum of 7 years of working experience as a Testing and Commissioning Engineer in a similar industry. Familiarity with Protection & Control and Sub-Station protection, including all protection panels for various voltage levels (400/132/33/11kV) such as BusBar protection, line protection, BS protection, BC protection, transformer protection schemes, stability, load shedding, and capacitor protection. Strong knowledge of all Control panels for different voltage levels, including AVR, ABTS, ACCS, and AMR. Strong knowledge of SAS design, testing, and commissioning. Good knowledge of preparing interface (CID) files with SAS systems. Ability to influence internal stakeholders and functions laterally and upwards to achieve common project goals. Ability to communicate key project issues succinctly to senior leadership using appropriate visual aids. Desired Characteristics Ability to manage customer, partner, and external relations effectively under pressure while maintaining focus on business and project goals. Demonstrated ability to foster genuine team dynamics and shared ownership of project goals. Capability to lead projects and make collaborative decisions. Strong sense of urgency and drive for results. Proactive approach to acting as a change agent and contributing to wider business operational improvement and evolution initiatives.

d086c9bc797f65b4.description: About the Role Med City Pharma is seeking an experienced and results-driven Key Account Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is within the pharmaceutical sector and involves developing strategic relationships with key healthcare accounts to drive business growth and ensure sustainable market performance. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute strategic account plans for hospitals, pharmacy chains, wholesalers, and government accounts to achieve sales, market share, and profitability targets. Drive product enlistment in hospital formularies and pharmacy chain listings, while expanding product availability across key accounts. Manage contracts, tenders, and negotiations in compliance with company policies, pharmaceutical regulations, and government procurement requirements. Coordinate with distributors to ensure timely order fulfillment, product availability, and effective inventory and consumption management. Lead, coach, and develop the Key Account Specialists team to achieve business objectives. Monitor account performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify business opportunities and drive growth. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 7 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. At least 3 years of proven leadership experience in managing and developing teams. Proven experience in Key Account Management, preferably handling hospitals, pharmacy chains, wholesalers, and government accounts. Strong knowledge of tenders, contracts, product enlistment, and healthcare market dynamics. Required Skills Excellent negotiation, communication, strategic planning, and leadership skills. مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة من الصراف الآلي بالفرع، وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها من كبير الصرافين. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن الحالات المخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 1-5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة d0a834e1b1616fb9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تركي بن مقرن للمقاولات عن مشغل مضخة مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل بجوار سد الشفيق في قرية الشقيق، ويشمل مسؤوليات تشغيل وصيانة المضخة لضمان استمرارية تدفق المياه بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد مضخة المياه بشكل دوري وفقاً للجدول الزمني المحدد. التحقق من جاهزية المضخة وتوافر المياه اللازمة للتشغيل. فتح صمامات المدخل والمخرج لضمان تدفق المياه بشكل صحيح. تشغيل المضخة بما يتوافق مع خطط العمل المتفق عليها. مراقبة أداء المضخة باستمرار لضمان كفاءتها. تنفيذ برنامج الصيانة الوقائية لمضخة مياه السد للحفاظ على عملها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال تشغيل وصيانة المضخات. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بجدول العمل ومتطلبات الموقع. تفاصيل الموقع وبيئة العمل يقع موقع العمل بجوار سد الشفيق في قرية الشقيق، حائل. يشترط أن يكون سكن المتقدم لا يبعد عن موقع العمل بمسافة تزيد عن 10 كيلومترات لضمان سهولة الوصول والالتزام بجدول العمل. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بمهام التشغيل والصيانة. الراتب يبلغ الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور 4000 ريال سعودي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة تركي بن مقرن للمقاولات.

d0af81c86d302ad2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مصفوفة الانظمة للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة، حيث يتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تجهيز مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية في الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الهندسية ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها. حفظ البيانات والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الكهربائية. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق عمل في شركة مصفوفة الانظمة للمقاولات العامة، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

d090e133b99402f4.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to enhance projects and redefine ambition. The company's values guide its consulting approach and define the individuals sought to join its team. The Role of 4D BIM Manager The 4D BIM Manager supports clients and project teams in developing and maintaining information requirements and standards. This role involves developing and managing processes within a common data environment and leading the information management function for project teams. The manager advises on, innovates, develops, and implements processes described within the ISO19650 series, including how information is produced and assured for digital delivery. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on a large luxury mixed-use development where Mace provides project management consultancy services. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain organizational standards, procedures, and governance frameworks for 4D planning and schedule simulation. Define 4D requirements within BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), project delivery requirements, and digital standards. Ensure alignment with ISO 19650 information management principles and organizational BIM requirements. Establish quality assurance processes for model and schedule integration. Lead the creation and maintenance of 4D models by integrating BIM models with Primavera P6 or equivalent project schedules. Develop construction phasing, logistics simulations, and sequencing visualizations. Validate schedule logic through model-based simulations and identify sequencing conflicts, interfaces, and delivery risks. Support project teams in evaluating alternative construction strategies and recovery plans. Produce animations, time slices, and visual simulations for project reviews and executive reporting. Coordinate with BIM Managers, Project Controls teams, GIS specialists, and project stakeholders to maintain accurate and reliable 4D environments. Manage the aggregation of multi-disciplinary models for district, precinct, and program-level planning. Ensure data consistency between models, schedules, and reporting platforms. Facilitate workshops focused on construction sequencing, interfaces, accessibility, operations, and logistics planning. Develop dashboards, executive reports, visual presentations, and stakeholder communication materials. Create high-quality visual outputs suitable for project governance reviews and senior leadership presentations. Support integration of 4D outputs into Power BI and digital twin initiatives where applicable. Lead and mentor 4D planners, BIM coordinators, and digital delivery specialists. d053ff31d7295304.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ايفارا للهندسة عن فني تصميم داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للمبتدئين لاكتساب خبرة عملية في مجال التصميم الداخلي وتخطيط المساحات، بالإضافة إلى التنسيق بين التخصصات الهندسية المختلفة. سيعمل فني التصميم الداخلي بدوام كامل، ويتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. مهام الوظيفة سيعمل فني التصميم الداخلي بالتعاون مع أصحاب الخبرة، مما يتيح له اكتساب خبرة عملية في إعداد رسومات التصميم الداخلي التفصيلية واختيار المواد والتشطيبات والتصميم ثلاثي الأبعاد. كما سيتعامل مع متطلبات المشاريع في قطاعات الرعاية الصحية والمشاريع التجارية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في إعداد رسومات التصميم الداخلي التفصيلية ومخططات توزيع المساحات والأثاث ورسومات الورش الخاصة بأعمال النجارة والتجهيزات، تحت إشراف المهندسين والمصممين ذوي الخبرة. التعاون مع فرق الهندسة المعمارية والإنشائية والميكانيكية والكهربائية والصحية (MEP) لضمان توافق مفاهيم التصميم الداخلي مع النماذج الفنية ومتطلبات تسليم المشاريع. المساعدة في إعداد لوحات الأفكار والتصميمات الإلهامية وجداول المواد والتشطيبات، بما في ذلك البحث عن الموردين والتنسيق معهم. المساعدة في إنشاء النماذج ثلاثية الأبعاد والتصاميم المرئية والعروض التقديمية لمراجعتها من قبل العملاء وفريق العمل الداخلي. المساعدة في إعداد مستندات مناقصات التصميم الداخلي ومراجعة جداول الكميات (BOQ) والمواصفات الفنية وملفات التقييم الفني. التعرف على كود البناء السعودي (SBC) واللوائح البلدية المحلية وتطبيقها، بالإضافة إلى إرشادات السلامة وسهولة الوصول. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصميم الداخلي. الموهبة والدقة في التفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بالتعاون مع أصحاب الخبرة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة في الرياض فقط، وهي فرصة للمبتدئين لبناء أساس قوي في مجال التصميم الداخلي ضمن فريق عمل متخصص. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

d094d6d614311281.job_title: Senior Field Civil Engineer Ras Al Khair
d094d6d614311281.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Field Civil Engineer for its operations in Ras Al-Khair, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Ras Al-Khair, approximately 100 kilometers north of Jubail Industrial City, with accommodation provided in Jubail Industrial City. The role requires daily commuting between Jubail and Ras Al-Khair. The Field Civil Engineer will be responsible for overseeing multiple contractors on large-scale civil engineering projects within the Jubail and Ras Al-Khair Industrial Cities, ensuring adherence to health, safety, and quality standards. Project Context Bechtel has managed the Jubail project in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia since the mid-1970s. Saudi Arabian Bechtel Company (SABCO) serves as the Management Services Contractor (MSC) for the Royal Commission, managing design submissions and overseeing construction work performed by local contractors. The project scope includes new residential communities, iconic buildings/bridges, major site preparation, commercial buildings, mosques, schools, hospitals, sports facilities, clinics, universities, utility services and infrastructure, roads and highways, and port and pipeline expansions. This position is designated as Single Status only. Key Responsibilities Supervise the construction of large-scale highways and infrastructure projects throughout the project lifecycle, including testing and commissioning. Review and approve shop drawings, vendor design packages, and all site-related quality and health and safety documentation. Maintain a zero-accident policy on site by participating in client health and safety programs and conducting regular audits. Proactively eliminate rework activities by reviewing drawings and specifications and coordinating with other discipline specialists. Support contractors in preparing and submitting technical queries and implementing quality assurance systems in line with Royal Commission procedures. Represent the client in conducting quality, health, and safety inspections, preparing punch list items, and leading the closure of outstanding comments with contractors. Coordinate with the project team and contractors to identify defects, raise non-conformance reports, and ensure corrective procedures are implemented. Monitor site material quantities and approve contractors' monthly invoices as the client's representative. Coordinate with stakeholders to assist contractors with traffic detour plans and road closures. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in civil engineering, specifically in the design and construction of highways and bridges. Technical proficiency in asphalt and reinforced concrete construction, including earthworks, drainage, and reinforced concrete structures. Ability to independently work with contractors while representing the client on site. Competence in reading, analyzing, and interpreting design drawings and specifications, and proactively identifying conflicts between disciplines. Experience in overseeing multiple utility construction projects. Strong understanding of quality assurance and health and safety documentation and implementation on construction sites. Work Environment and Supervision The Field Civil Engineer will receive direction from the Resident and Assistant Resident Engineer, as well as technical guidance from the Project Field Engineer. This role involves taking responsibility for all site-related activities, including health, safety, and quality. The position requires close collaboration within a multi-disciplined team of field engineers and safety engineers. Complimentary breakfast and lunch are provided for Ras Al-Khair assignees on workdays. About Bechtel Corporation Bechtel is a global company committed to diversity and inclusion, fostering an environment where every colleague feels they belong. The company offers robust benefits to support its employees in tackling complex challenges. Bechtel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, considering all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
